title: Hydrogen Bomb

Description

The Hydrogen Bomb is a missile costing 5 000 000 gold.

It is sent out using a Missile Silo. It leaves behind fallout. Its explosion radius completely irradiates tiles that are within a distance of 80 and has a high chance to destroy those tiles within a range of 100, using Euclidian distances. This means that if well aimed, the Hydrogen Bomb can be used to destroy SAMs without a chance to be destroyed.
